One of the few games that ive spent over 100hours on and its only been a couple of weeks! Other games ive spent over 100hours on are League of legends and World of warcraft. All monsters of a game. There is so much grind in this game its ridiculous. The only way i would recommend this game to anyone is if they invest atleast 30USD to it to buy the battle pass and have some game currency for small things. If you can shell out $50, its even better because you can kickstart your game with an ultimate character that will help you unlock everything else. Prepare to be frustrated with loot drops but getting the loot you want is an amazing feeling. Its a looter shooter in a MMO world with the mission maps having a cap of 4 players. Its great to play with friends and great to play solo which is how im playing it. Dont expect to be chatting in the world chat all that much because it is overwhelmed with too much chat. 

The game is an absolute grind to be successful. You'll be doing the same thing over and over and over and over again but for some reason its not all that boring to me because its all needed to get to where you want to be. Its a never ending farm. Im actually not even sure if i would recommend this game to anyone that doesnt have their life together. I cant wait to play more.

I'd say it's kind of like Warframe lite? Some like the similarities, some hate it. If you want a similar distraction, this is a fun one to drop in and out of.  It has great graphics due to Unreal 5 and decent gun play and a fair amount to do to keep you busy.  I've definitely had some fun with this one. While the story is nothing to be amazed by, I honestly wasn't expecting too much. I rarely like a looter/shooter story in the first place. It's good for what it is. There are some mistakes in voices and text, lips will be off unless the VA worked to closely match the Korean lip sync. For example, it seems like Blair's VA really tried to make his lines work with the lip movement, actually came out good. Others seem like it was done by AI /shrug.

Recent updates by the devs have been actually really good, and communication seems transparent so far. It's a nice change of pace, and frankly unexpected in this case. Hopefully it stays the same in the coming months.

While I see why some don't like the cash shop, it's not mandatory except for char slots which you can run out of if you are successfully farming every decedent. I spent some on it, cause hell, I often pay 60+ for a game and don't get 100 hours out of it. You do you, though.

Game is very fun and it's free, so why not try it?  I've played quite a few hours of Warframe on my xbox and it does integrate the same unique weapon mod system, although it plays more like Destiny.  Both Warframe and Destiny are fantastic games, and this one appears to be similar so far.

Unfortunately, I cannot recommend at this time because the drop rates for key character and weapon parts are misleading and very inaccurate.  I've been grinding one extremely long mission for a 20% drop rate item for 3 days now and haven't gotten it yet.  The drop rates appear to be more akin to XX% of people will have a chance to see this part drop as opposed to 20% drop on mission completion.  If you have content in a game that no one can get...you don't actually have content at all.  They are going to need to employ a mercy system or something else to ensure players can actually progress before I will recommend this game to others or consider any kind of investment myself.

Update: I tried to get back into this game.  Inventory is a bear.  I didn't play long before I remembered that you can't play a single mission without having to pause for 5-10 min to manage your inventory.  Very quickly re-uninstalled.

The game itself is fun at the start and was very addictive.... but then I got to the end game.
I am now so bored of the game I think I might have to stop playing, because they made it way to much of a grind to get anywhere...
Example in order to get an item you need to craft.
First you need to find an item that drops from completing a task, with a 20% drop rate... 
Then you need to collect material from another task in order to summon a boss.. this just take more time.
And finally you can go to fight the boos to get the key to open then item from step one... which will have if your lucky a 5-15% chance of dropping... If the item you are after doesn't... well off you go to start again

In my experience this can lead to you having to do the SAME task over 100 times with no real guarantee of getting what you want..... hence BORING!!!!!!

Don't get me wrong I don't mind grinding with a clear goal in sight... but this is just repetitive boring tasks, some taking a lot longer to complete than others.
